Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up and welcome to Redwood Inference — really excited to see what you're building at Small Startup. This is an automated & friendly note from our intake flow to get you started quickly.

Two quick paths based on how deep you want to go:
- 15-minute Quickstart: a fast, engineer-friendly intro to get you generating with the hosted API and local config tips.
- 30-minute Deep Dive: product + engineer session where we walk through integration patterns, performance knobs (batching, kv caching), and cost optimizations.

Pick one below and I'll send a calendar invite:
- 15 min (recommended for engineers): https://cal.redwood.com/j/jonas-15min
- 30 min (recommended for product + infra): https://cal.redwood.com/j/jonas-30min

If you'd prefer an engineer to join, reply here and we'll add an engineer to the invite (typical for dev teams integrating inference at scale).
